principle: Engineering enclosure quality only. No category depends on the sign or size of any R''' value, and 'R''' becomes positive' is not a success criterion.
metric: contraction_factor = R1_radius / R2_radius for the same inputs (m = 1 reported; all m recorded), computed separately for the midpoint interval and the whole-cell interval

applied_to.manufactured_stress_fixtures: measured with CERTIFIED (exact) C_e0, C_o0 on sigma-symmetric systems (part method_comparison)
applied_to.cusum_cell0_forecast: computed from committed K1 magnitudes; C_e0 = committed certified C_upper; C_o0 is the NON-CERTIFIED float operator estimate, reported with a predeclared sweep {estimate, 10, 50, 466, C_upper}; the forecast category is conditional on a future certified C_o0 not exceeding the estimate

next_step_rule.REPAIR_CELL0_CONDITIONING_AGAIN: if all R2 qualification gates pass and the cell-0 midpoint forecast is at least MATERIAL_IMPROVEMENT at the float C_o0 estimate, but a certified input or real wiring required to run the graded method on real cells is missing
next_step_rule.SEEK_ALTERNATE_K5_ROUTE: if the cell-0 midpoint forecast is below MATERIAL_IMPROVEMENT even at the float C_o0 estimate, or the graded method fails soundness
